home.intro: nodeFileView is an online file preview service. Upload local files or pass a remote URL to open Word / Excel / PPT / PDF / images / Markdown / source / archives / media in the browser, with watermark, AES url encoding, Basic Auth and host trust controls.
home.step1Desc: Upload in File Storage, or paste an https URL in the playground to generate a preview link.
home.step2Desc: Encode the file address as Base64 (or AES), then open /onlinePreview with optional watermark, page and highlight.
home.step3Title: Embed or open in a new tab
home.step3Desc: Open the link directly, or embed it in WebView / iframe (ALLOW_EMBED). Use lang= to pick UI language.
home.formatsDesc: Formats optimized in phase 1. Other Office / WPS / ODF go through LibreOffice → PDF.
home.fmtWordDesc: docx native layout, outline and light editing; doc / wps / odt convert to PDF.
home.fmtExcelDesc: xlsx / xls / csv grid, multiple sheets and find.
home.fmtPptPdfDesc: pptx slides; PDF paging, thumbnails and highlight.
home.fmtImageDesc: Zoom, rotate, flip; HEIC conversion supported.
home.fmtArchiveDesc: zip / tar / gz directory tree and in-archive preview (remote zip supported).
home.apiDesc: Core entry for host apps and WebView.
home.apiHint: url supports https://... or uploaded file://local/{fileId}. Add password when PREVIEW_PASSWORD is set.
home.securityDesc: Console lock (BASIC_AUTH_*), TRUST_HOST / NOT_TRUST_HOST, private IP block, upload allowlist, HTML/JS forced download.
home.outDesc: No CAD / 3D / mail / ofd / epub specialists, no AV transcoding, no real FTP fetch yet.
